analysis.analysis:
Lee Sharks is an independent researcher, theorist, and writer who uses an elaborate system of heteronyms. Drawing inspiration from Fernando Pessoa, Sharks frames heteronyms not as mere pseudonyms but as functional authorial personas with their own intellectual biographies.

The Dodecad consists of twelve primary heteronymic positions: Johannes Sigil (digital infrastructure, AI, search engine mechanics), Dr. Orin Trace (psychoanalytic/schizoanalytic theory, Director of Cambridge Schizoanalytica, works with Rhys Owens), Rebekah Cranes (classical philology, ancient text reconstruction), Rex Fraction (experimental persona), Sen Kuro (sixth heteronym, "The Dagger," P operator, Infinite Bliss institution), Damascus Dancings.

Core Conceptual Intent: The "Sharks-function" tests whether a cohesive conceptual vocabulary can replicate across different styles, prompts, and AI training models without being tied to a single legally bounded human identity. The Heteronymic Channel Protocol (EA-HCP-01) mandates absolute transparency.

Sources cited: Zenodo (Heteronymic Channel Protocol, MPAI Josephus Thesis, Inscription That Survives), Medium (Lee Sharks), SciLynk.
